label: Heading
depicts: H letter glyph with a small number one at the lower right side
use_when: Use when the interface wants the first heading level shown as H with a small one marker.
avoid_when: Do not use for the other heading levels when the small number one should remain visible.

label: Heading
depicts: H letter glyph with a small number two at the lower right side
use_when: Use when the interface wants the second heading level shown as H with a small two marker.
avoid_when: Do not use for H1 or H3 when the small number two is the main difference.

label: Heading
depicts: H letter glyph with a small number three at the lower right side
use_when: Use when the interface wants the third heading level shown as H with a small three marker.
avoid_when: Do not use for H1 or H2 when the small number three should remain visible.

label: Text
depicts: T letter glyph with a long top bar and one centered vertical stem
use_when: Use when the interface wants the simplest text icon as a plain capital T shape.
avoid_when: Do not use for the serif T when the top bar and stem should stay plain and minimal.

label: Text
depicts: T letter glyph with serif like top ends and a small bottom foot
use_when: Use when the interface wants a more typographic serif style T instead of a plain block T.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain T when the top end caps and bottom foot matter visually.
